items.title: Using IoT Sensors for Soil Monitoring (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Using IoT Sensors for Soil Monitoring (PDF 117, printed 113).

blocks.text: IoT sensors zameen ki nami, darja hararat aur ghizaiyat (nutrients) ka data foran (real time) jama kar sakte hain. Yeh maloomat kisanon ko data par mabni faisle karne mein madad deti hai, jaise faslon ko kab aur kitna pani dena hai, jis se efficiency barhti aur wasail bachte hain.

blocks.prompt: IoT soil sensors kya napte hain aur kisan ko kis faisle mein madad dete hain?
blocks.explanation: Zameen ki nami (moisture), darja hararat aur nutrients (ghizai ajza) foran (real time) napte hain. Kisan faisla karta hai ke kab aur kitna pani dena hai, jis se pani aur wasail bachte hain.

items: IoT sensors: nami, darja hararat, nutrients; data par mabni faisle.
